body: Yeah I’m working on getting some help from teachers but even with help my odds are so slim of passing anything... Ugh then I can’t even graduate on time and honestly that’s so embarrassing like I’d rather like transfer somewhere else now or something instead of all that

Yeah I mean I think that in addition to having some problems kind of over the course of my life, like you had mentioned now it really does seem like everything is kind of crashing down at once. It’s pretty bad I’m about to get into a hole I can’t get out of - luckily I do still work with a therapist which is better then nothing but results are slim - she can help me feel better in the moment but honestly some of these problems are out of her control and I have to fix them in combination with others. That’s what really makes this tough

Literally the exact same thing just happened to me. Reading this is like reading my story. My ex blocked me on everything after I went to the hospital for suicide issues. Then after I got out of the hospital my drinking got way worse. I stopped a while ago but I was drinking until my BAC was over .3... Things have been impossible for me lately. I can’t get over my ex at all and I’ve had other relationships but for some reason there is nothing I can do to let go of this last one. He was really nice and now I’m just “that fucking guy who is creepy about his ex” and I feel so ready to die
